name: AdventureLog---Frontend
description: Discover new places, track your adventures, and share your experiences with friends and family.

variables.name: Public Server URL
variables.description: What the frontend SSR server uses to connect to the backend. Do NOT change the port.

variables.name: Origin
variables.description: Match Web UI Port. Not needed if using HTTPS. If not, set it to the domain of what you will access the app from.

variables.name: Body Size Limit
variables.description: The maximum upload size to the server. Should be changed to prevent someone from uploading too much! Custom values must be set in kilobytes.
